## Summary

```text
Consumer caller on @consumer-v1
  → resolve provider defaults and reviewed repository settings
  → preview or write with the same reviewed revision
  → replay existing proposals with the recorded producer

Successful main Quality run
  → record the tested producer revision
  → advance consumer-v1 by fast-forward
```

The migration helper carries forward the existing bootstrap, policy, and fresh-series settings. Migration rehearsal preserved the effective configuration of all six current callers, including the sandbox. Standard onboarding uses the shared native PR metadata check for scoped Conventional Commit titles, release context, and authored commits.

Refs #180.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Use one stable Rolling Release workflow reference and provider-managed release defaults.
impact: Compatible fixes and historical replay updates arrive without editing consumer workflow pins or replay lists.
required_action: Migrate once from an immutable caller to consumer-v1 after the provider activates it. Move reviewed bootstrap values and deliberate overrides into .release-log/settings.json.
```

## Evidence

- **Before** Review Bot’s caller at `f74198f` selected the v0.8.0 writer, which reported an incomplete linear sequence for the stack landing in Review Bot #145.
- **After** Read-only collection with the v0.8.3 association code accepted the exact same landing, `95f5e872da0a5ba51e6de141f835638dab4f12ee`, from Review Bot’s existing v0.2.0 tag. [Review Bot #145](https://github.com/lhajoosten/review-bot/pull/145) · [Association fix #178](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/pull/178)
- The final commit passed the full local `pnpm check` hook. All 971 behavioral tests and 22 architecture fixtures passed, and the documentation built.
- The six migration candidates preserve repository identity, release-branch filters, write toggles, App secret aliases, and reviewed policy. All six proposed callers passed Actionlint.

## Merge danger

**Door** Two-way. The provider can restore a known-good implementation with a forward revert while preserving the historical producer records.

**Blast radius** Consumer release automation. Stable promotion requires a configured provider App and protected ref, plus the disposable Actions rehearsal before activation. Live rehearsal, consumer migration, and Lint Gate comment publishing remain pending. [Rollout guide](docs/release-workflow.md#provider-promotion-and-rollback) · [Lint Gate #38](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lint-gate/issues/38)

pullRequests.body:
Closes #182

## Summary

```text
Rolling Release
├── Set up Rolling Release
│   ├── One install command for release and PR readiness
│   └── Run Rolling Release manually to preview
└── Maintain Rolling Release
    ├── Verify published image
    └── Resume publication
```

Use the same names in Actions and the guides. Share the Node and pnpm setup across three Quality jobs.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Set up Rolling Release and PR readiness in one step.
impact: The setup guide covers previewing and turning on releases. A single maintainer page covers checking the published image and resuming publication.
required_action: null
```

## Evidence

- **Before** Setup was split across the release and metadata guides. Preview, image verification and recovery used several workflow names.
- **After** `pnpm verify` and actionlint passed. The documented setup passed local tests for a fresh install, an existing install, an absent stable ref and a failed download.
- Expanded Quality YAML matched the previous version exactly. The other changed workflows and templates differ only in their display names.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way. The descriptions and shared setup can be reverted in one change.

**Blast radius** Documentation and Actions display names. The workflow paths, permissions and required check names are preserved. Live setup and consumer migration depend on the separate `consumer-v1` activation in #180.
